versions.changelog:
drivethru-odoo-sales-assistant v0.1.0

- Initial release of the BaconCo Sales Order Assistant for Odoo, enabling comprehensive sales order entry and management through the drivethru_mcp server’s sales tools.
- Supports full order lifecycle: creating drafts, handling the grid (style/color/size/qty/decorations), attaching decorations and requests, adding per-unit customizations, running pre-submission checklists, and confirming orders.
- Guides users through proper order-building for Make-to-Order manufacturing, including reading customer notes and handling required checklists.
- Requires environment credentials (ODOO_MCP_URL and ODOO_MCP_TOKEN) for operation.
- Provides clear operator workflow and key non-negotiable processes for order accuracy and compliance.
